## Editorial checklist

Please confirm by checking each that applies :

- [ ] The video is an on-site walkthrough OR a serious documentary about the site (not clickbait, not stock-footage AI narration)
- [ ] The creator is registered in `data/creators.json` (if not, this PR also adds them)
- [ ] The video covers the site(s) named, not just mentions them briefly
- [ ] No content is racist, hateful, or mocks the cultures depicted
- [ ] I've read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [EDITORIAL_GUIDELINES.md](../docs/EDITORIAL_GUIDELINES.md)
